name: language-country
description: A hypergraph describing which languages are spoken in which countries. Nodes represent countries and hyperedges represent languages spoken by the countries.
source: University of Groningen. 2016. "World Languages." University of Groningen Open Data. http://opendata.rug.nl/data sets/5c6ec52c374249a781aede5802994c95_0?geometry=153.457%2C15.653%2C-122.52%2C76.276. Accessed through Resource Watch, (date). www.resourcewatch.org.

hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., false).

edges_metadata.language: (STRING) Name of the language spoken (e.g., English).
